name: Becky
text: Tommy Muldoon deck only. Uses (2 ammo). Each resource gained from Tommy Muldoon's [reaction] ability may instead be placed on Becky, as ammo. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
text_cn: 托米·马尔登牌组专用。使用(2子弹)。 从托米·马尔登的[reaction]能力获得的资源可以改为放置在贝基上，作为子弹。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。这次攻击你+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
